meaning: The complete real S1 driver and its freeze precheck are prepared and frozen here. Nothing in this plan has been executed: zero torch import, zero model load or construction, zero forward/backward, zero optimizer or PPO step, zero environment, zero sampling, zero checkpoint write. S1 requires a separate decision-side execution permission.

entry_points.precheck: r75_s1_precheck.py (pure stdlib, no torch, no r75_frozen import, read-only)
entry_points.runner: r75_s1_runner.py (lazy torch / r75_frozen import inside the run path only)

input_identity.adapter: r75_replay_adapter.load_qualification_batch(row, tape) - the existing qualified adapter; no new collector, no environment, no episode/GAE switch, no field back-filling, no rewriting of the recorded log-probs

r75_guard.note: the verified mechanisms are NOT touched by this revision

canonical_onpolicy.note: onpolicy.py is NOT in the canonical run directory; it is reached through the same wiring, from the tight-budget round that v2_common.enter_round() puts on sys.path. Pinned by R75_S0_IMPORT_BOOTSTRAP_REPAIR_20261015 by reading that live file; no replacement copy is introduced.

canonical_cost_math.note: cost_math.py is NOT in the canonical run directory either; it is imported by configure_source_imports() from the stage-A directory that v2_common.enter_round() puts on sys.path, and r75_frozen reads the already-imported object back from sys.modules instead of importing a second copy. Pinned by R75_S0_IMPORT_BOOTSTRAP_REPAIR_20261015 by reading that live file; the checkout copy under zhenghe-round42 carries the SAME digest, so the resolved path is what distinguishes the two.

r75_frozen.revision: A-R1 keeps the failed A source byte-identical; physical_step_category/prefix remain in the fee route and out of the scientific return

gae_default_distinction.requirement: the S1 run must report the LIVE values 1.0 / 0.5 and must never silently fall back to the 0.95 / 0.05 defaults
gae_default_distinction.enforcement: r75_frozen._verify_canonical_bindings() reads common.GAE_LAMBDA / common.ETA_LAMBDA / common.GAMMA back from the configured module at import time and refuses the run if they are not 1.0 / 0.5 / 1.0

gate_only_controller.two_head_equality: both independent heads are set to the OLD single action_head values, so route_logits reproduces the single-head behaviour by construction
gate_only_controller.no_late_scaling: no late x .10 or any other head scaling is applied
gate_only_controller.alignment: r66.likelihood_alignment must pass within common.LOG_PROB_TOLERANCE = 1e-6; the gate prior never enters the forward
gate_only_controller.qualification_only: these parameters NEVER become the R71 research INIT and NEVER become an effect training checkpoint
r71_research_config_unchanged: 8 trainable objects (early_head, late_head, task_value_head, cost_head; 390 scalars)
beta=1.00 gate prior is a training-loss term only

A1_nonempty_adam_critic_only_control_ste.design: Adam(lr=3e-4) over the SAME eight trainable objects as the native path. ONE synthetic physical step in which only the two critic modules carry a legal controllable non-zero gradient; both actor heads and the trunk receive none, so the actor/trunk parameters do not move and the original behaviour probabilities are preserved. The step is pre-charged to the central ledger before optimizer.step() and recorded at the real entry.
truthful_records: for each of the eight objects: grad is None / non-None
for each of the eight objects: Adam exp_avg / exp_avg_sq present / absent
an absent state is recorded as absent and NEVER fabricated as non-empty
full_state_saved: all Adam state values with the eight-object name mapping

A2_source_actual_update.design: From the SAME A1 state, call r75_native_ppo_update(update_index=0) once through the real path: trainer.batch_samples + GAE, the metered r66.likelihood_alignment pass (168 candidate rows over 66 calls), the DATA_ORDER_SEED shuffle, 4 epochs x 1 minibatch, the beta=1.00 / ready_cut=147 gate prior, the clipped surrogate + dual critic + entropy + gate loss, the global clip over the eight trainable objects, optimizer.step.

A3_full_state_save_restore_same_update.design: Restore the exact pre-update A1 state into FRESH objects and re-execute the SAME update (update_index=0). The re-run starts from the restored pre-state and does not advance the scientific cursor; it replaces the trial, it is not a second committed update.

accounting.joint_record_semantics: the central unit joint_record counts BATCH-READ events, not original joint records and not environment episodes: 2 batch-read events re-expose the same 66 unique records 132 times; the environment guard stays 0/0/0
accounting.no_quota_borrowing: the plan may not convert headroom into extra steps; no extra forward verification, parameter/state comparison does not forward

metering_contract.attachment: every real forward attaches ONLY to R75Resources.production() (the canonical durable root)
metering_contract.installation: resources.ensure_trunk_meter(controller, ...) is installed BEFORE any possible forward, for BOTH controllers (A2 and A3)

phase_split.alignment: cumulative snapshot at the end of r66.likelihood_alignment minus pre_meter
phase_split.epochs: final cumulative snapshot minus the alignment-end snapshot
phase_split.invariant: alignment + epochs == total for EVERY component

metering_contract.no_dodge: the meter is never uninstalled to escape accounting; no aggregate replaces the entry; no double charge
metering_contract.reconciliation: every Adam.step is pre-charged and reconciled item-by-item against the durable counter; resources.verify_or_fail() runs before any work

compared_value_by_value: all Adam state values with the eight-object name mapping
scientific numeric returns of the update record
excluded_in_advance_and_accounted_separa: central cumulative resource counters and ledger event sequence numbers
temporary file paths and process ids
the A3 trunk-entry meter absolute cumulative readings (A3 is a second controller, so its absolute counts are expected to differ and are reconciled, not diffed)
comparison_contract.forbidden_exclusions: no real scientific difference may be excluded; the exclusion list is fixed here before the run

stop_conditions: any source, data or ledger byte-identity mismatch
the R58 ep0 state-dict key mapping into the five-module controller fails
likelihood_alignment exceeds 1e-6 (data is never rewritten, alignment never disabled)
any Adam object whose recorded grad/state presence contradicts the measurement
the A3 re-run record differs from A2 in any compared field
any ledger refusal, any fixture/simulated attachment, any environment construction attempt
any checkpoint save that omits the optimizer state or the RNG state

execution_discipline.no_auto_retry: an anomaly keeps the failure and the consumed originals and stops immediately
execution_discipline.no_technical_reserve: ordinary exhaustion is never auto-upgraded to the technical reserve
execution_discipline.no_refund: a failed step is never refunded
execution_discipline.no_scratch: no charged scratch, dev, preheat, small trial or extra probe
execution_discipline.history_preserved: the R74 >=16 physical-step lower bound and every earlier gap stay permanently recorded

not_covered: torch import, model load/construction and the state-dict mapping outcome
any real or synthetic optimizer step, PPO update or replay
the real collector, real episodes, closed-loop simulation, any evaluation block
full multi-batch training and any research checkpoint
any communication-policy effect, cost or task-outcome conclusion

canonical_ledger_frozen_snapshot.rule: the precheck must reproduce this snapshot byte-for-byte; no bootstrap append and no rebuild is permitted

s1g_execution_contract.scientific_invariants: The existing frozen RUN_PLAN candidates, comparison_contract, data identity, 66/168 batch, trunk-freeze, 8 trainable objects, LR, epochs, minibatch, optimizer order and return semantics remain unchanged; category/prefix metadata is diagnostic/accounting only.
